<script>
(function () {
    function initMobileAccordion() {
        document.querySelectorAll('.dropdown-item.inner').forEach(function (item) {
            if (item.querySelector('.inner-item-header')) return;

            var ul = item.querySelector('ul');
            var primaryLink = item.querySelector('.dropdown-item-primary');
            if (!ul || !primaryLink) return;

            var header = document.createElement('div');
            header.className = 'inner-item-header';
            item.insertBefore(header, primaryLink);
            header.appendChild(primaryLink);

            var btn = document.createElement('button');
            btn.className = 'inner-toggle-btn';
            btn.type = 'button';
            btn.innerHTML = '<i class="icon doof-03-flechadcha"></i>';
            header.appendChild(btn);

            btn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                e.stopImmediatePropagation();
                var opening = !item.classList.contains('open');
                item.classList.toggle('open', opening);
                btn.classList.toggle('open', opening);
                ul.style.display = opening ? 'block' : 'none';
            });
        });
    }

    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initMobileAccordion);
    } else {
        initMobileAccordion();
    }
})();
</script>

(function () {
    function initMobileAccordion() {
        document.querySelectorAll('.dropdown-item.inner').forEach(function (item) {
            if (item.querySelector('.inner-item-header')) return;

            var ul = item.querySelector('ul');
            var primaryLink = item.querySelector('.dropdown-item-primary');
            if (!ul || !primaryLink) return;

            var header = document.createElement('div');
            header.className = 'inner-item-header';
            item.insertBefore(header, primaryLink);
            header.appendChild(primaryLink);

            var btn = document.createElement('button');
            btn.className = 'inner-toggle-btn';
            btn.type = 'button';
            btn.innerHTML = '<i class="icon doof-03-flechadcha"></i>';
            header.appendChild(btn);

            btn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                e.stopImmediatePropagation();
                var opening = !item.classList.contains('open');
                item.classList.toggle('open', opening);
                btn.classList.toggle('open', opening);
                ul.style.display = opening ? 'block' : 'none';
            });
        });
    }

    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initMobileAccordion);
    } else {
        initMobileAccordion();
    }
})();

<script>
(function () {
    function initMobileAccordion() {
        document.querySelectorAll('.dropdown-item.inner').forEach(function (item) {
            if (item.querySelector('.inner-item-header')) return;

            var ul = item.querySelector('ul');
            var primaryLink = item.querySelector('.dropdown-item-primary');
            if (!ul || !primaryLink) return;

            var header = document.createElement('div');
            header.className = 'inner-item-header';
            item.insertBefore(header, primaryLink);
            header.appendChild(primaryLink);

            var btn = document.createElement('button');
            btn.className = 'inner-toggle-btn';
            btn.type = 'button';
            btn.innerHTML = '<i class="icon doof-03-flechadcha"></i>';
            header.appendChild(btn);

            btn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                e.stopImmediatePropagation();
                var opening = !item.classList.contains('open');
                item.classList.toggle('open', opening);
                btn.classList.toggle('open', opening);
                ul.style.display = opening ? 'block' : 'none';
            });
        });
    }

    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initMobileAccordion);
    } else {
        initMobileAccordion();
    }
})();
</script>

		<script>
			;(function () {
				const slider = document.getElementById('testimonialsSlider')
				const track = slider.querySelector('.slides-track')
				const slides = Array.from(track.querySelectorAll('.single-slide'))
				const dotsContainer = document.getElementById('sliderDots')
				let current = 0
				let animating = false
				let autoplayTimer = null

				function startAutoplay() {
					autoplayTimer = setInterval(() => {
						goTo((current + 1) % slides.length)
					}, 5000)
				}

				function resetAutoplay() {
					clearInterval(autoplayTimer)
					startAutoplay()
				}

				slides[0].classList.add('active')

				slides.forEach((_, i) => {
					const dot = document.createElement('button')
					dot.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Slide ' + (i + 1))
					if (i === 0) dot.classList.add('active')
					dot.addEventListener('click', () => { goTo(i); resetAutoplay() })
					dotsContainer.appendChild(dot)
				})

				function goTo(index) {
					if (index === current || animating) return
					animating = true

					const prev = slides[current]
					const next = slides[index]
					current = index

					prev.classList.remove('active')
					prev.classList.add('exiting')

					next.classList.add('active')

					function onExitDone(e) {
						if (e.propertyName !== 'opacity') return
						prev.removeEventListener('transitionend', onExitDone)
						prev.classList.remove('exiting')
						animating = false
					}
					prev.addEventListener('transitionend', onExitDone)

					dotsContainer.querySelectorAll('button').forEach((d, i) => {
						d.classList.toggle('active', i === current)
					})
				}

				const DRAG_THRESHOLD = 50
				let dragStartX = 0
				let dragMoved = false
				let dragging = false

				function dragStart(x) {
					dragStartX = x
					dragMoved = false
					dragging = true
					slider.style.cursor = 'grabbing'
				}

				function dragEnd(x) {
					if (!dragging) return
					dragging = false
					slider.style.cursor = ''
					const delta = x - dragStartX
					if (Math.abs(delta) >= DRAG_THRESHOLD) {
						dragMoved = true
						if (delta < 0) goTo(Math.min(current + 1, slides.length - 1))
						else goTo(Math.max(current - 1, 0))
						resetAutoplay()
					}
				}

				slider.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
					if (dragMoved) {
						e.preventDefault()
						e.stopPropagation()
						dragMoved = false
					}
				}, true)

				slider.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
					if (e.button !== 0) return
					dragStart(e.clientX)
				})
				window.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
					if (!dragging) return
					e.preventDefault()
				})
				window.addEventListener('mouseup', (e) => dragEnd(e.clientX))
				slider.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
					if (dragging) {
						dragging = false
						slider.style.cursor = ''
					}
				})

				slider.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => dragStart(e.touches[0].clientX), { passive: true })
				slider.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => dragEnd(e.changedTouches[0].clientX), { passive: true })

				startAutoplay()
			})()
		</script>

			<script>
				;(function () {
					const section = document.querySelector('.home-2026 .ai-platform')
					if (!section) return

					const h2 = section.querySelector('h2')
					const container = section.querySelector('.container')
					const icon1 = section.querySelector('.icon-1')
					const icon2 = section.querySelector('.icon-2')
					const icon3 = section.querySelector('.icon-3')

					const SPREAD_START = 50,
						SPREAD_END = 22
					const LIFT_START = -30,
						LIFT_END = 0

					// Topes de tamaño del h2 (px) por breakpoint.
					const END_CAP_DESKTOP = 80,
						START_CAP_DESKTOP = 36
					const END_CAP_MOBILE = 42,
						START_CAP_MOBILE = 18
					// Fracción del ancho del container que puede ocupar el título.
					const FIT_RATIO = 0.96

					// Mide (vía canvas) el font-size máximo al que el título cabe en
					// una sola línea dentro del container. Se recalcula en resize.
					const measureCanvas = document.createElement('canvas')
					let fitEnd = Infinity
					function computeFit() {
						if (!container) {
							fitEnd = Infinity
							return
						}
						const cs = getComputedStyle(h2)
						const text = (h2.textContent || '').trim()
						if (!text) {
							fitEnd = Infinity
							return
						}
						const ctx = measureCanvas.getContext('2d')
						ctx.font = cs.fontWeight + ' 100px ' + cs.fontFamily
						const widthAt100 = ctx.measureText(text).width || 1
						const cStyle = getComputedStyle(container)
						const avail =
							container.clientWidth -
							parseFloat(cStyle.paddingLeft || 0) -
							parseFloat(cStyle.paddingRight || 0)
						// Regla de tres: px que llenan el ancho disponible en una línea.
						fitEnd = ((avail * FIT_RATIO) / widthAt100) * 100
					}

					// El tamaño final crece con el ancho disponible (desktop y mobile)
					// pero nunca supera el tope ni lo que cabe en el container.
					function getH2Sizes() {
						const desktop = window.innerWidth >= 992
						const end = Math.min(desktop ? END_CAP_DESKTOP : END_CAP_MOBILE, fitEnd)
						const startCap = desktop ? START_CAP_DESKTOP : START_CAP_MOBILE
						return { start: Math.min(startCap, end), end: end }
					}

					function getProgress() {
						const rect = section.getBoundingClientRect()
						const mid = rect.top + rect.height / 2
						const start = window.innerHeight
						const end = window.innerHeight * 0.25
						return Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (start - mid) / (start - end)))
					}

					function onScroll() {
						const p = getProgress()
						const h2Sizes = getH2Sizes()
						const size = h2Sizes.start + (h2Sizes.end - h2Sizes.start) * p
						const sep = SPREAD_START + (SPREAD_END - SPREAD_START) * p
						const lift = LIFT_START + (LIFT_END - LIFT_START) * p

						h2.style.fontSize = size + 'px'
						icon1.style.transform = `translateX(-${sep}px)`
						icon2.style.transform = `translateY(${lift}px)`
						icon3.style.transform = `translateX(${sep}px)`
					}

					function onResize() {
						computeFit()
						onScroll()
					}

					window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true })
					window.addEventListener('resize', onResize, { passive: true })
					computeFit()
					onScroll()
				})()
			</script>

					const card1Filters = document.querySelector('#card-1 .content .filters')
					const card1FiltersMob = document.querySelector('#card-1 .content-mob .filters')
					const SCALE_MIN = 0.75
					const SCALE_MAX = 1.0

					const card3Spans = document.querySelectorAll('#card-3 .content span')
					const card3Stats = [
						{ el: card3Spans[0], target: 9.6, decimals: 1, prefix: '', suffix: '%' },

												{ el: card3Spans[2], target: 55.7, decimals: 1, prefix: '', suffix: '%' },
					]
					let card3Triggered = false

					function countUp({ el, target, decimals, prefix, suffix }, duration = 1400) {
						const start = performance.now()
						function tick(now) {
							const t = Math.min((now - start) / duration, 1)
							const eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3)
							const value = eased * target
							const formatted = decimals > 0 ? value.toFixed(decimals) : Math.round(value).toLocaleString('en-US')
							el.textContent = (prefix || '') + formatted + suffix
							if (t < 1) requestAnimationFrame(tick)
						}
						requestAnimationFrame(tick)
					}

					function update() {
						const rect = section.getBoundingClientRect()
						const viewportH = window.innerHeight
						const scrolled = -rect.top

						const p0 = Math.max(0, Math.min(2, scrolled / viewportH))

						const p1 = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, scrolled / viewportH))
						const scale = SCALE_MIN + p1 * (SCALE_MAX - SCALE_MIN)
						card1Centered.forEach((el) => {
							el.style.transform = `translateX(-50%) scale(${scale})`
						})
						if (card1Filters) card1Filters.style.transform = `scale(${scale})`
						if (card1FiltersMob) card1FiltersMob.style.transform = `translateX(-50%) scale(${scale})`

						if (!card3Triggered && scrolled >= viewportH * 2.5) {
							card3Triggered = true
							card3Stats.forEach((stat) => countUp(stat))
						} else if (card3Triggered && scrolled < viewportH * 2.5) {

						}

<script>
(function () {
    function initMobileAccordion() {
        document.querySelectorAll('.dropdown-item.inner').forEach(function (item) {
            if (item.querySelector('.inner-item-header')) return;

            var ul = item.querySelector('ul');
            var primaryLink = item.querySelector('.dropdown-item-primary');
            if (!ul || !primaryLink) return;

            var header = document.createElement('div');
            header.className = 'inner-item-header';
            item.insertBefore(header, primaryLink);
            header.appendChild(primaryLink);

            var btn = document.createElement('button');
            btn.className = 'inner-toggle-btn';
            btn.type = 'button';
            btn.innerHTML = '<i class="icon doof-03-flechadcha"></i>';
            header.appendChild(btn);

            btn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                e.stopImmediatePropagation();
                var opening = !item.classList.contains('open');
                item.classList.toggle('open', opening);
                btn.classList.toggle('open', opening);
                ul.style.display = opening ? 'block' : 'none';
            });
        });
    }

    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initMobileAccordion);
    } else {
        initMobileAccordion();
    }
})();
</script>

                ul.style.display = opening ? 'block' : 'none';

    }

        /**

        *
        * @param {String} category Usually is the object the user has interacted
        *                with (ie: 'Video')
        * @param {String} action  The type of event, like 'play' or 'click'
        * @param {String} label  A descriptive label to classify events.
        */
        function sendAnalyticsEvent(category, action, label) {
            dataLayer.push({
                'event': 'eventGA',
                'user': {
                    'login': false
                },
                'page': {
                    'pageTitle': document.title,
                    'pageUrl': document.location.pathname
                },
                'eventGA': {
                    'category': category,
                    'action': action,
                    'label': label
                }
            })
        };

        /*
        * Click listener to send events.
        *
        * Tags should be like this:
        * <a href="#" data-ga-category="my_category" data-ga-action="my_action" data-ga-label="my_label">
        *
        */
        window.addEventListener('click', e => {
            ds = e.target.dataset
            if (ds.gaCategory !== undefined && ds.gaAction !== undefined && ds.gaLabel !== undefined) {
                sendAnalyticsEvent(ds.gaCategory, ds.gaAction, ds.gaLabel)
            }
        })
    </script>
